label: Delimiter step of maximum-length (L=9) sequences, and to a lesser degree L=3
explanation: Fires only on the <DEL> step (100% of activation mass), never during the original or copy phases. Strongly length-dependent: it fires on 57% of L=9 delimiters (82% of mass), 12% of L=8 (10% of mass), 8% of L=3 (7.5% of mass), and almost never for L=4..7. The top activations are all L=9 sequences. Within L=9 the first original token (which is the next output) shifts the firing rate: b, 3, h, f, z have the highest rates. Sequences with more digits fire somewhat more often. Neither effect is clean enough to raise F1, so roughly 43% of L=9 delimiters remain false positives. Dev scores: P 0.56, R 0.83, F1 0.67, mass recall 0.90.
